content: Elifɑsi Temɑɡii u Yoobu wisɑ u nɛɛ,

content.text: wi u bwisi mɔ u koo tɔnu wisi kɑ ɡɑri yi yi ǹ ɑrufɑɑni mɔ?
U ko n ɡɑri yɑrɑmɔ nɡe woo?
Wee ɡɑri yi ɑ ɡeruɑ ɑ kɑ tii yinɑ mi, yi ǹ sɑ̃ɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu.
Gɑri yi ɑ sɑɑrɑ mini kpuro sɔɔ,
sɑri yi yi koo tɔnu somi.
Wunɛ, ɑ mɑm Gusunɔn nɑsiɑru tɛɛsimɔwɑ,
mɑ ɑ win bɛɛrɛ yɛ̃ru kpeerɑsiɑmɔ.
Wunɛn kom kɔ̃sumɑ mu sɔ̃ɔsirɑmɔ wunɛn nɔɔn di.
Mɑ ɑ ɡɑri ɡerumɔ kɑ bwisi.
Wunɛn nɔɔn ɡɑriyɑ yi nun tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃ɛmɔ, n ǹ mɔ nɛ.
Gɑri yi ɑ ɡeruɑ mi kpuro,
yiyɑ yi wunɛn torɑnu sɔ̃ɔsimɔ.
Wunɑ bɑ ɡbiɑ bɑ tɑkɑ kuɑ hɑnduniɑ sɔɔ?
Wunɑ ɑ ɡbiɑ ɑ wɑ̃ɑ bɑ sere ɡunɡunu kuɑ?
A Gusunɔn ɡɑri ɑsiriɡii swɑɑ dɑki?
A win bwisi mwɑ kpuro, ɑ yi wunɛn tiin sɔ̃?
Mbɑ ɑ yɛ̃ ye bɛsɛn tii sɑ ǹ yɛ̃.
Yɛ̃ɛ terɑ̀ ɑ mɔ te bɛsɛn tii sɑ ǹ mɔ.
Bɛsɛn suunu sɔɔ, tɔmbɑ wɑ̃ɑ
be bɑ seri bururɑ bɑ tɔkɔnu kuɑ n kere wunɛn tundo.
A bɛsɛn ɡɑri yi sɑ nun sɔ̃ɔwɑ kɑ lɑɑkɑri mɛɛrɑwɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ piiminu,
yìn min di Gusunɔ u nun nukuru yɛmiɑsiɑmɔ?
Mɑnɑ wunɛn bwisikunu kɑ nun dɔɔ.
Mbɑ wunɛn nɔni ɡɔsikiɑ ninin tubusiɑnu.
Gɑri yi ɑ sɑɑrimɔ mini, Gusunɔwɑ ɑ kɑ mɔru mɔ̀.
Tɔnu u koo kpĩ u n dɛɛre?
Wi bɑ mɑrɑ, u koo kpĩ u n yibɑ Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ?
Gusunɔ ù kun win ɡɔrɑdobɑ nɑɑnɛ kue,
mɑ u ǹ wɔllu mɛɛrɑ tɑ dɛɛre,
wunɛ tɔnu ɑmɔnɑ kɑɑ kɑ kpĩ ɑ n dɛɛre win wuswɑɑɔ,
wunɛ wi ɑ rɑ kɔ̃sɑ ko kiri kiri nɡe mɛ bɑ rɑ nim nɔ.
Tɛ̃, Yoobu, ɑ mɑn swɑɑ dɑkio kpɑ n nun ɡɑri sɔ̃.
Kon nun sɔ̃wɑ ye nɑ wɑ.
Sɔ̃ɔsi te bwisiɡibu bɑ sɔ̃ɔsi,
bɑ tu ɡiɑwɑ ben sikɑdobɑn min di.
Be tɔnɑwɑ Gusunɔ u rɑɑ tem mɛ wɛ̃,
sɔɔ ɡoo rɑɑ mɑɑ sɑri be sɔɔ.
Adɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃so u ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ nɔni swɑ̃ɑru sɔɔ
win wɑ̃ɑrun tɔ̃ru kpuro sɔɔ.
Kpɑ u n ɡbɑ̃sukunu nɔɔmɔ ni nu koo nùn bɛrum mwɑ.
Wi u koo nùn kɑm koosiɑ, u koo nùn wɔri subɑru sɔɔ.
Tɔn kɔ̃so wi, u ku rɑ n yĩiyɔ u yɑm wɔ̃kuru dukɑ suuri.
Domi tɑkobi rɑ n nùn mɑrɑwɑ.
U rɑ n sirenɛwɑ bɑɑmɑ, u n kɑsu ye u koo di.
U yɛ̃ kɔ mɑ yɑm wɔ̃kurɑ nùn mɑrɑ.
Mɑ u nɑnde wɑhɑlɑ kɑ nɔni swɑ̃ɑrun sɔ̃,
ye yɑ nùn wɔriɔ nɡe sinɑ bokon tɑbu kowobu
be bɑ tɑbun sɔɔru kpɑ.
Domi u Gusunɔ seesi.
U Dɑm kpuroɡii nɔɔ kuurimɔ.
U kɑ̃kɑ u Gusunɔ tɑbu wɔri,
win tɛrɛrun sinum sɔ̃.
Win wuswɑɑ bɑllimɔ.
Mɑ win ɡɑ̃ɑnu nu yɑɑ tɑɑsinɛ.
U wɑ̃ɑ wuu si bɑ kɔsukɑ sɔɔ,
sìn diɑ bɑ deri, mɑ yɑ wɔrumɑm dɔɔ.
U ǹ ɡobi mɔ. Win dukiɑ kun mɑɑ kuurɑmɔ.
U ǹ mɑɑ yĩsiru yɑrimɔ win temɔ.
U ǹ kpɛ̃ u ɡɔɔn tɔ̃ru dukɑ suuri.
Win bweseru kpuro tɑ koo dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑwɑ.
Kpɑ Gusunɔ u nùn wom wure u ɡo.
Ù n kɔ̃sɑ nɑɑnɛ sɑ̃ɑ u tii nɔni wɔ̃kuɑwɑ mi.
Domi kɔ̃sɑ yen ɑreyɑ u koo wɑ.
Are yi, yi koo nɑwɑ u sere ɡbi.
Win bwese kɛrɑ kun mɑɑ seemɔ,
nɡe dɑ̃ɑ kɑ̃ɑsɑ ye yɑ ǹ mɑɑ kpɑrɑmɔ.
U ko n sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe resɛm yèn bii birenu bɑ wɔkɑ,
ǹ kun mɛ nɡe olifin dɑ̃ɑ tèn wɛ̃su bɑ dɛrɑ.
Tɔn kɔ̃so u ǹ bweseru wɑsi.
Dɔ̃ɔ u koo wi u nɔm birɑn kɛ̃nu mwɑɑmɔn yɛnu wɔri.
Wi u kɔ̃sɑ bwisikɑ, kɔ̃sɑ u koo ko.
Domi bwisi kɔ̃si yiyɑ yi rɑ n wɑ̃ɑ win nukurɔ.
Kpɑ yi n nùn nɔni wɔ̃kuɑ.
